response.sql:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_rating
), above AS (
  SELECT p.avg_per_day, o.overall_avg
  FROM per_rating p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_per_day > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day_of_above_ratings,
       AVG(avg_per_day - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_overall_avg
FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: Each rating contributes equally to the across-rating average, and each film contributes equally to its rating average. NULL ratios are ignored by AVG; NULLIF also prevents division by zero if a duration is zero.
